summary: The test suite is fundamentally broken and cannot run as provided. Critical files are missing: test/test_helper.bash (which defines run_pipeline_case), test/check_workflow_structure.py, test fixture files (commits-patch.txt, commits-minor.txt, commits-major.txt), and the .github/workflows/semantic-version-bumper.yml workflow file. Coverage is limited to three happy-path scenarios (patch/minor/major bumps) with no error handling, edge case, or unit-level testing. Rigor is extremely shallow—tests only assert on presence of output strings and job success counts; they never verify actual file contents (version file updates, changelog appends, or package.json modifications). Design separates pipeline and structure concerns reasonably, but the test suite depends entirely on an unshown run_pipeline_case implementation and makes fragile assumptions (exactly 2 'Job succeeded' lines). No validation of changelog format, handling of empty commit lists, package.json parsing, malformed input, or whitespace edge cases. The suite would not catch regressions in most code paths.
